snippet.title: RUSH: Apex Edition | PlayStation VR2 | Available November 6th, 2025
snippet.description:
Take the plunge. 👉 Add RUSH: Apex Edition to your PlayStation wishlist today! https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017027

RUSH: Apex Edition is the definitive VR wingsuit adventure, fully remastered for PlayStation®VR2.

Soar down towering mountains, dive through canyons, and race under rock arches at breakneck speed. Whether you’re flying solo, chasing the top spot on global leaderboards, or competing in 12-player online multiplayer races, the adrenaline rush has never felt this real.

New in the Apex Edition:
- Fully remastered visuals: global illumination lighting, new skies, weather effects, scene density & textures
- Headset + Sense or DualSense™ controller haptics with adaptive triggers
- Expanded online races (12 players, up from 8)
- Global leaderboards & new proximity chat for ultimate immersion
- 90fps on PS5 | 120fps enhanced on PS5 Pro

RUSH: Apex Edition launches exclusively on PS VR2 November 6th, 2025.

👉 Subscribe for more updates from The Binary Mill.

#PSVR2 #RUSHVR #RUSHApexEdition #VirtualReality #Wingsuit
